tools.name: ig5_profile
tools.description: Return IG5 engines, projects, active tools and skills, plus the calling agent's host Goal availability/state. recovery={case_ref:{path,sha256}} separately reads a bounded recovery case and returns a failure/dependency plan. Alternatively recovery={observations:{recordings:[{id,sha256}],target_sha256,offset,limit}} imports committed debug-trace reports into ordered, source-bound observation pages; no native execution, invented intermediate state or VM/business proof. Alternatively recovery={roles:{recordings:[{id,sha256}],target_sha256}} samples recorded addressing/load/control observations using an owned disassembly-only job; candidates retain ordinary-program ambiguity and do not prove VM roles. Alternatively recovery={flow:{roles_ref:{id,sha256},target}} revalidates a committed role report and recordings, selects a contiguous candidate-to-indirect window, verifies exact raw-file mapping, and uses Java full-state plus source-prefix projections for structural load/index/target dependencies. All stores and ordinary-program ambiguity remain; no VM, semantic-nonconstancy or business proof. All recovery modes save immutable reports and reject other profile options. For sustained reverse engineering use ig5-reverse-agent and native Goal tools. Optionally switch core (8 tools) or full (40) for the calling agent. workspace manages caller notes and separate system dossier evidence for an explicitly opened target; updates require expected_task_revision. History stats/archive/restore retain report IDs and refs. capabilities=true reads capability dimensions and scoped acceptance history without probes; workspace action=brief aggregates current task, stale evidence, persistent failures and at most three suggestions, with no engine computation. recovery.role_validate rebinds a compared context to every original recording and checks observed entry inputs and held-out relations. recovery.program can alternatively read image_ref={path,sha256} plus contract_ref for the three exact-SHA owned-source reference images only. recovery.function_check independently checks that executable virtual model over a finite contract domain, optionally against recording_runs; modelContractAccepted never means native CPU, universal or whole-VM proof. No target is executed. memory={action:"restore"|"search"|"read"|"expand"|"checkpoint"|"status"} accesses the executing session's local LCM history after compaction; source refs carry exact hashes, summaries are unverified navigation. Use memory separately.

tools.name: ig5_ir
tools.description: level=discover generates bounded candidate addresses from a preferred entry ea using pinned disassembly only (max_instructions1..128; default128). Optional follow_direct_calls=true follows canonical E8 callee entry, never a return/ABI summary. Pass returned candidatePath to explicit Java project; semantic/flags refusals stay unchanged. It does not execute the target. Inspect Ghidra raw/high p-code in the bundled Reverse or Ghidra database. For raw/high call with target, ea, level and optional max_instructions/max_blocks; omit action and all kernel-only parameters. Example: {target,ea,level:"raw",max_instructions:256}. level=kernel uses owned PE/ELF loading and native C decompilation. level=trace recovers input/output expressions from recorded x86-64 VM traces with Triton in an isolated worker, without launching the binary or opening a database. Requires explicit trace files/hashes, entry/exit, input/output registers and initial_flags; omit action. Explicit trace_image_only=true with trace_target_sha256 and native image reports permits offline replay without reading the original file; original-file comparisons remain unavailable. Trace proofs cover recorded windows/environment, not whole-binary coverage or function return completion. level=lift uses the pinned experimental open-source Mergen backend to lift raw-file AMD64 PE32+ functions to LLVM IR. Requires target, preferred ea and explicit initial_flags low12 bits, optional lift_inline/max_blocks (1..4096; default 512). No action/max_instructions/database/trace parameters. Target never executes. IR, diagnostics and immutable report refs are returned; all lifts remain partial/unverified and never count as business recovery. Read-only and bounded.

level.description: discover: bounded raw-file AMD64 candidate path from ea, optional max_instructions1..128(default128), no other parameters. Follows fallthrough/canonical direct JMP; optional follow_direct_calls=true follows canonical E8 callee. RET always stops without a return/ABI summary; other control/cycle/overlap/budget/unmapped boundaries stop. No target execution or semantics proof. Submit its candidatePath to project with explicit java decoder; original flags/control refusals remain. project interprets a fixed path. compose combines closed all16-GPR/memory templates, finite constant-condition loops and explicitly guarded indirect targets. Existing process/memory/DAG budgets unchanged; no independent equivalence, reachability or full recovery claim.

action.description: Only level=kernel accepts action. Omit entirely for other levels.

follow_direct_calls.description: discover only, default false. Explicit true follows only byte-bound unprefixed E8 rel32 to its callee entry; RET still stops. No execution, call-return, ABI or stack summary. Same128-instruction budget.

composition_plan.description: compose only. sequence requires paths; constant-loop requires prefix, body and suffix. Each template is a strict explicit preferred-address path with unique addresses; repeats between applications allowed. Each template must close its own flags and retain all16 GPRs. No observations, certificates or supplied summaries. At most128 distinct instructions,1024 provided occurrences,64 actual applications,1024 logical instructions/1024 accessed bytes; inference attempts separately bounded. Unknown/nonterminating loops reject; a chosen indirect target is only a guard.

representation.description: Default flat preserves the original depth128 refusal. Explicit transition-chain supports sequence only: exact state-binding equalities carry all16 GPRs, memory and guards between bounded local expressions. Binding sources must be resolved; retained depth and expanded dependency depth are reported separately. Same node/reference/work/process budgets; no loop inference or reachability proof.

template_mode.description: Default strict. Explicit opaque-effects or opaque-status requires sequence with representation=transition-chain and an independent schema. Byte-bound PUSHFQ/RDTSC/canonical16-bit BSWAP models use fresh unknowns per application. opaque-status preserves within-template defined/modeled status-bit correlations in stored flag images; per-layer flagImages reference actual STORE values, all unknown/AF bits remain free. Each template must close its own status dependencies; CPU flags are not supplied/exported across templates. All raw work, ordered writes, guards and existing budgets retained; normalization shares4096 visits.

indirect_mode.description: Default reject. guarded-target retains actual-target==next-entry as continuation guard and the complementary dynamic exit with post-control state, including RET stack changes. Does not discover or prove reachability of targets.

composition_plan_ref.description: compose only, exclusive with composition_plan. Read an existing regular UTF-8 JSON address plan (at most65536 bytes) by absolute path and expected SHA-256. Same plan validator and budgets; never executes the file. Prefer this for long/repeated arrays instead of transcribing them. Response/report binds the original blob, normalized plan digest and exact counts; errors after worker submission include the verified digest and counts.

projection_mode.description: project only; strict is default. guarded-path retains conditional guards and side exits. opaque-effects uses fresh unknown values for byte-bound PUSHFQ/RDTSC/undefined16-bit BSWAP. Explicit opaque-status additionally overlays only status bits with prior classified modeled definitions onto the PUSHFQ unknown image; initial/undefined/unmodeled flags including unmodeled AF remain unknown. Preserves ordered STOREs/aliases and original budgets; separate schema, no independent CPU/business proof. Project modes cannot be combined. Compose selects its explicit template_mode separately.

projection_decoder.description: project/compose only. native is the existing default. Explicit java uses the pinned official Ghidra Java SLEIGH API, without the IG5 native decode DLL or a database. Both decode and state computation share the original deadline and owned-process limits; full raw instruction semantics and byte provenance remain checked. No target execution, automatic security-policy changes or business-equivalence claim.

projection_path.description: project only: exact preferred instruction VAs in execution order. Contiguous fallthrough/direct jumps and byte-bound unprefixed E8 near CALLs checked (including canonical rel0 complete RSP-8/STORE/BRANCH-next shape, original raw retained); next address after CALL must be the callee entry, never a guessed call-return/ABI summary. Stack writes retained. strict: conditional/indirect/return only at the end. guarded-path: intermediate conditional next addresses must match exactly one successor. Repeated addresses, middle indirect control and unknown internal loops rejected; only complete bounded dead-frame register BSR/BSF internal shapes may be elided.

projection_registers.description: project only: final full-width GPRs to retain. Initial GPRs and coherent byte memory are free; all stores and final control are retained. No initial observed values or flags substitution.

lift_inline.description: level=lift only: explicit preferred main-image file-backed addresses to inline. No guessed or blanket inlining.

trace_image.description: Optional per-path record_image report; independent runs require their own snapshots. Exclusive with shared trace_image.

recording.description: Optional per-path recorded addresses and EFLAGS for independent ASLR runs; all four fields required together. Overrides shared recording defaults, never argument symbols.

trace_chunk_reports.description: Consecutive ig5_dbg record_trace report UUIDs for one recorded path; exclusive with traces. Total 4 MiB; default 50k instructions, explicit max_instructions up to 100k. Checks saved hashes, process/thread, GPR/flags/RIP and pause continuation.

trace_exit.description: Recorded last instruction VA, hex; explicitly includes/excludes RET

trace_image.description: Optional immutable ig5_dbg record_image reference for packed/decrypted main-image code. Preserves sparse holes and original-file mismatches.

trace_image_only.description: Explicit offline recording-only mode. Every path requires a hash-bound native record_image report, plus trace_target_sha256. target must match its recorded absolute path label; the original file is never read or restored. Original-file comparisons remain unavailable. Default false retains original-file verification.

trace_target_sha256.description: Expected original target identity as recorded at capture; required only with trace_image_only=true. Not a fresh original-file verification.

trace_inputs.description: Explicit equal-width x/y pair: RDI/RSI (SysV) or RCX/RDX (Win64), including named low parts

trace_runtime_base.description: Optional explicit loaded main-image base, hex; recorded runtime VAs bind to target RVAs. Does not apply relocations or model other modules.

initial_flags.description: Required explicit flags assumption, hex. Trace: recorded EFLAGS. Lift: modeled low12 bits 0x0..0xfff, not native-capture binding or complete architectural flags.

optimize.description: Kernel-only local width-aware constant folding; does not modify target bytes

max_instructions.description: Discover default128, range1..128, no larger path budget. Also supported for raw/high p-code and kernel analysis. Trace default 50000 per path; explicit long-recording budget 1..100000, without increasing file, solver or deadline limits.

engine.description: Explicit backend. Omit to use the configured primary static engine; results identify their source.

tools.name: ig5_sync
tools.description: Preview or apply an explicit one-way changeset between two opened databases for the SAME binary hash. Copies selected names, EOL comments or bounded bytes by RVA. Preview includes before/after evidence and a digest. Apply requires that digest, rechecks hash, database revisions and current values, and remains approval-gated. Partial failures report applied rows; there is no cross-engine atomic Undo.

engine.description: Explicit backend. Omit to use the configured primary static engine; results identify their source.

tools.name: ig5_crypto
tools.description: Inspect, decrypt XOR/AES-CBC/CTR/GCM, decompress or verify bounded bytes. action=recover searches bounded single/repeating XOR keys and validates supplied/extracted AES candidates; it does not exhaust strong AES key spaces. Candidate keys are sensitive SHA-256 refs; transform recipe.key_ref reuses a complete recover candidate without exposing key bytes. Producer-marked sensitive refs are rejected as ordinary input; unbound refs/local files keep raw access and are not a secret access-control boundary. Explicit expected or GCM authentication distinguishes verified plaintext from statistical guesses. No sample execution or database write. action=result reads a prior report.

ref.description: sha256: analysis blob reference; avoids resending large buffers. Producer-marked sensitive keys are only accepted as controlled recovery.key_source or recipe.key_ref. Unbound refs retain explicit raw data reads.

result_id.description: For ref input, explicit producer report ID to preserve provenance; never inferred from a shared hash

path.description: Explicit local regular input file; read only with a byte budget

target.description: Optional result association only; no open session needed for file/ref/inline input

select.description: For action=result, optional bounded dot path such as flows.0

ref.description: sha256: analysis blob reference; avoids resending large buffers. Producer-marked sensitive keys are only accepted as controlled recovery.key_source or recipe.key_ref. Unbound refs retain explicit raw data reads.

result_id.description: For ref input, explicit producer report ID to preserve provenance; never inferred from a shared hash

path.description: Explicit local regular input file; read only with a byte budget

key_source.description: Explicit bounded key-material input, up to 64 KiB. Bound producer/static inputs must match the ciphertext target, engine and sample identity. Material bytes are not saved in reports.

key_offset.description: Explicit repeating XOR key start offset

engine.description: Optional result association or static source backend; standalone byte/file/ref analysis does not require an engine.

tools.name: ig5_protocol
tools.description: Inspect bytes, parse PCAP/PCAPNG, reassemble directions, decode schemas or infer bounded framing/field hypotheses. state_infer consumes a <=1 MiB JSON manifest {version:1,traces:[{id,start:"session-start"|"unknown",complete:boolean,events:[{direction:"client_to_server"|"server_to_client",symbol,sourceId?,complete?}]}],holdout?:[]} through the existing input path/ref/bytes. It builds an observed prefix tree and optional future-equivalence merge hypothesis. state_validate replays new manifest.traces against state_model.result_id; reports accepted/rejected/unknown, overlap and counterexamples separately from training. Explicit session boundaries are required; TCP does not establish them. Models do not prove hidden server state, semantic meanings or complete protocol behavior. No network sends or sample execution. action=result reads a saved report; use select=state.holdout or state.observedModel.states.0 for bounded detail.

ref.description: sha256: analysis blob reference; avoids resending large buffers. Producer-marked sensitive keys are only accepted as controlled recovery.key_source or recipe.key_ref. Unbound refs retain explicit raw data reads.

result_id.description: For ref input, explicit producer report ID to preserve provenance; never inferred from a shared hash

path.description: Explicit local regular input file; read only with a byte budget

target.description: Optional result association only; no open session needed for file/ref/inline input

select.description: For action=result, optional bounded dot path such as flows.0

offset.description: Relative input-byte offset; capture the bounded full source first, then select this range. Useful with infer candidate.decodeInput.startOffset.

length.description: Selected byte length; preserve skipped prefix/tail in the source reference. Useful with infer candidate.decodeInput.byteLength.

samples.description: When present, these are the training messages; the primary input is retained as provenance rather than added to training.

holdout_samples.description: Independent validation messages; train and holdout combined are limited to 64 samples and 1 MiB.

result_id.description: For state_validate, saved state_infer producer report; reconstruction verifies the full model digest, never a truncated UI preview.

engine.description: Optional result association or static source backend; standalone byte/file/ref analysis does not require an engine.

tools.name: ig5_capture
tools.description: Read independent proxy history and saved HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS evidence; never start a listener or send requests. get redacts common headers/query values; bodies are untrusted. export returns exact captured bytes as SHA refs. inspect_payload classifies bounded headers/text; materialize saves complete unencoded bytes under a fixed SHA path without executing/opening an engine. state_trace builds an authenticated trace manifest from caller-selected ordered complete HTTP exchanges, with explicit application-session boundaries, direction, source hashes and separate holdout. Default event symbols are request method/path hash and response status; optional body-field selects 1..8 bytes. Pass returned input unchanged to ig5_protocol state_infer/state_validate. review makes passive observations, not exploit verification. Unseen server code and protocol semantics are not inferred. Use approved ig5_capture_control for start/stop/replay.

id.description: Persistent capture report UUID returned by list/get

session_id.description: Capture session UUID; required for replay and recommended for stop/get/export
Capture session UUID; required for replay and recommended for stop/get/export

start.description: Explicit application conversation boundary; never inferred from proxy session

complete.description: Caller declares the conversation observation complete; does not prove protocol termination

traces.description: state_trace: caller-selected ordered non-overlapping HTTP application conversations

session_id.description: Capture session UUID; required for replay and recommended for stop/get/export

start.description: Explicit application conversation boundary; never inferred from proxy session

complete.description: Caller declares the conversation observation complete; does not prove protocol termination

items.description: Persistent capture report UUID returned by list/get

holdout.description: Separate held-out conversations, with no repeated capture records

symbols.description: Default request method/path hash and response status symbols; optional body-field selects exact 1..8 bytes in wire order

body.description: Body direction to export, inspect or materialize; default response for HTTP or captured direction for a WebSocket frame

tools.name: ig5_capture_control
tools.description: APPROVAL REQUIRED. Control IG5 independent local HTTP/HTTPS and WS/WSS proxy or replay one complete HTTP request. start binds only 127.0.0.1 with explicit origin scope; configure your client to use the returned port. tls=true enables HTTPS interception with a local CA the client must explicitly trust; default CONNECT remains encrypted. stop closes owned connections. replay requires saved id and active session_id, sends once to the original scoped origin with optional bounded request edits and never follows redirects. WebSocket frames/handshakes cannot be replayed. Remote side effects cannot be undone; failure/cancellation can leave outcomeUnknown. No Burp is required.

id.description: Persistent capture report UUID returned by list/get

session_id.description: Capture session UUID; required for replay and recommended for stop/get/export

port.description: Loopback port; 0 chooses an unused port

scope.description: Exact HTTP/HTTPS origins, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000; no wildcard or URL path. WS/WSS use the matching HTTP/HTTPS handshake origin.

tls.description: Explicit HTTPS interception; does not automatically change system/browser certificate trust

request.description: Optional approved replay edits. Path remains on the original origin, headers merge by name, body replaces captured bytes. Host/framing headers are normalized.
